compose algorithms:

The following WindowKinds exist:
- VecInput
- PiecesSelectionInput (which is a Diagram with no diff, only piece selection)
- DesignDiffOutput (which is a Diagram with diff, no selection)
- DesignOutput (which is a Diagram with no diff, no selection)

Drag: VecInput, PiecesSelectionInput, DesignDiffOutput, DesignOutput
Delete: PiecesSelectionInput, DesignDiffOutput, DesignOutput
etc
